caption: The drawing depicts a large crucifix with a figure of a man, dressed in a red and yellow garment with black, green, and gold details, nailed to a cross. The cross itself is colored in red, gold, black, and gray with geometric patterns at the ends. The man has brown skin, a mustache and beard, dark hair, and is wearing a decorated garment, with blue pants and boots that have white and red accents. Below the crucified figure, there is a horizontal brown platform supporting seven smaller human figures. These figures are dressed in various colored garments, including red, brown, gray, and black, and are arranged in a row. One figure holds a drum, another appears to be holding a staff or stick, and the remaining figures stand with their hands by their sides. The background is plain and off-white, providing no additional detail or scenery.
title: Bulto; Saint Acacio
